set.body: Replace the explicit ANTs H5 rejection with an in-process JVM adapter backed by jHDF. Decode canonical ITK TransformGroup components into a portable ordered composite coordinate map, normalize LPS to RAS with Gale-backed affine math, preserve explicit direction/inverse semantics and provenance, and prove behavior with SimpleITK-generated fixtures plus JVM and JS gates.
set.title: Epic: Real ANTs/ITK HDF5 transform adapter
